kind: interactive CLI/editor coding agent and shared SDK

runtime.execution: Node/Bun shared AgentRuntime over Core SessionRuntime; provider async streams, actual shell children and host/SDK extensions. Current monorepo differs materially from old recursive extension-only Task architecture.
runtime.service_boundary: Core owns session/conversation/team state, host routing and managed MCP; shell can detach from runtime. Consumes providers/MCP, with hub/cloud surfaces present but bounded study focuses local CLI/SDK.

summary: Migrated shared SDK exposes programmable model/tool turn seams, configured heterogeneous delegation, persisted team mailboxes/runs and integrity-checked context projection; continuity and audit remain bounded.

inspection.scope: Selected source excerpts trace exposed entry/loop/request/action/result/state boundaries and relevant capability mechanisms; listed tests are read as source only.
inspection.limits: No acquired code executed, dependencies installed or live providers invoked. Claims concern this pinned snapshot; untraced catalog tools and dependency internals are not inferred.

actions.name: read_files
actions.output: Per-file content/error; cline:// oversized-result cache reads
actions.authority: Model tool policy and image capability

actions.name: search_codebase
actions.lifecycle: Parallel native executor requests with output/time bounds; detailed regex executor internals not traced

actions.name: run_commands
actions.input: One/multiple normalized commands, cwd from session
actions.output: Bounded output/errors; execution/PID log handle under detachment
actions.lifecycle: Shell children deadline/abort kill; host detach lets process continue
actions.authority: Model tool policy; operator execution controller

actions.name: skills / ask_question / submit_and_exit
actions.input: Skill name / question input / final result
actions.output: Skill instructions / host answer / terminal completion
actions.lifecycle: Awaited callback; submit closes successful run

actions.name: spawn_agent / configured agent tools
actions.lifecycle: Delegated runs; configured child provider and scoped tools
actions.authority: Model when feature enabled; configured policy not universal inheritance

actions.name: team_spawn_teammate / team_shutdown_teammate
actions.input: Agent ID, role prompt/runtime spec / target reason
actions.lifecycle: Lead manages persistent team; running respawn forbidden

actions.name: team_run_task / team_cancel_run / team_list_runs / team_await_runs
actions.output: Run ID, state/error and result summary
actions.lifecycle: Queued/active run lifecycle; idle-only per teammate
actions.authority: Enabled team requester; management subset scoped

actions.name: team_send_message / team_broadcast / team_read_mailbox
actions.output: Message receipt IDs / delivered count / mailbox bodies
actions.lifecycle: Notification on next model boundary; no automatic idle wake traced
actions.authority: Registered team sender; broadcast excludes lead

actions.name: team_task / team_mission_log / outcome catalog
actions.input: Task action or mission summary/evidence/nextAction; outcome fragments/reviews
actions.lifecycle: Shared team coordination; full outcome state machine not traced

actions.name: prepareTurn / beforeModel / beforeTool hooks
actions.input: Executable handler receives snapshot/request or call
actions.lifecycle: Before provider or tool; hook context flush after tool results
actions.authority: Installed extension/SDK program, not blanket model-native control

actions.name: compactCurrentSession
actions.lifecycle: Rejects running turn; persisted projection independent of canonical history

actions.name: restartWithCurrentMessages
actions.input: Mutated config plus canonical history and valid compaction state
actions.lifecycle: Stops current session, serializes startup generation
actions.authority: Host config path; no executable rebuild transfer

filesystem.detail: Plural file reads, editing/patch executors and cache URI reads; model tool set/provider routing can vary.

processes.detail: Spawned shell with progress, process tree abort/deadline and verified-identity detachment logs. Detached processes outlive a run; logs capped/retained24h.

code_actions.detail: Native shell and programmable SDK tools/hooks execute code; no exposed persistent model language kernel established in inspected default tool definitions.

persistent_kernel.detail: No Python/JS standing interpreter established in traced CLI/SDK/native executor paths; shell process launch is not credited as a kernel.

standing_database.detail: Session service uses internal indexed persistence and shell/custom tools can consume databases, but inspected builtins expose no dedicated model standing-DB contract.

workflow_programming.detail: Actual executable SDK prepareTurn/model/tool lifecycle hooks plus configured agents and team run/task tools; no dedicated model source-code workflow tool established.

multi_model.detail: Configured child definitions carry own provider/model and tools. Team messaging independently traced; default teammate builder inherits parent connection, so arbitrary per-spawn heterogeneous teams not inferred.

live_collaboration.detail: Real shared team mailbox/task/run system; busy recipient notification consumed before model and body read explicitly. Broadcast skips lead; idle mail read at next routed task, not IRC-style wake/delivery body immediately.

concurrent_work.detail: Adjacent parallel tool calls overlap with sequential barriers; separate teammate runs and event/persisted state exist.

steering_interrupt.detail: Pending operator input interrupts provider request while tools finish; whole-run external abort distinct. Team notification is a next-boundary mailbox hint.

turn_redefinition.detail: prepareTurn and beforeModel rewrite messages/tools/options, hooks alter tool policy/input/stop; terminal completion policy governs yield. Model direct agency narrower than SDK host hooks.

compaction.detail: Canonical-prefix fingerprint and separate working-context artifact guard resume projection; manual idle compaction versus automatic incremental summary. Basic/agentic/custom strategy bodies only partially traced.

context_repair.detail: Canonical transcript remains separately accessible and stale compacted prefix rejected. Manual fresh compaction, restore and host projection can reconstruct context; no dedicated model repair action traced.

original_audit.detail: Canonical messages plus selected hook audit events; documented request ID excludes hidden retries. Shell output/logs bounded and expire; saved chat is not comprehensive original audit.

audit_query.detail: Conversation history API, team mailbox/mission log and hook JSONL are separate inspection surfaces, not unified audit query engine.

hot_change.detail: Per-request beforeModel and shell description reflect changes; host model/mode restart preserves same history using stop/start barrier. No general default after affected workflow transaction traced.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Config restarts re-seed messages; persisted team recovery gives task instruction to inspect workspace/avoid duplication. This is neither unresolved-effect exact continuation nor quiescent executable outpost refit.

remote_services.detail: Provider model API and enabled remote/local MCP manager consume services; core host manages MCP shutdown. Wider hub/cloud implementation exists but not fully traced here.

self_improvement.detail: Generic editing, hooks/configuration and skill loading do not establish model-governed harness candidate evaluation/promotion in inspected paths.

complaints.detail: No native model frustration report with agent-state capture established in inspected builtins/team/native hooks. Mission log is ordinary progress coordination.

authority.detail: Yolo selects local backend; runtime tool policy/hook overrides and host approval can enable/disable/ask. Child scoped tools/configured policy behavior must be reviewed per deployment.

evaluation.detail: Inspected configured-agent/lifecycle/manual-compaction tests assert boundaries using mocked SessionRuntime/session manager, not live model/process correctness. Native source contains bounded retry/loop behavior.

time_order.detail: Parallel tool group results ordered, mailbox IDs monotonic per runtime and wall-clock sentAt; audit timestamps wall clock and detached PID/start-token differentiates reuse. No global causal order established.

evidence.claim: CLI supplies approval/question/submit callbacks, local backend in yolo, runtime hooks and session manager.
SIGINT/SIGTERM abort active session and cleanup stops it.
CLI starts Core session with config/hooks/team events then uses completed start result or sends prompt.
Per-run runtime is built with canonical history, tools, model, hooks and prepareTurn, then run/continued; startup abort forwarded at run-started.
Turn loop invokes provider request with retry and treats interrupted empty turn separately.
Tool results appended and emitted; terminal tool can finish run.
Actual provider model.stream(request) receives prepared request.
Only adjacent parallel tools overlap; sequential calls fence groups and Promise.all retains order.
Actual tool execution receives session/agent/conversation/run/call identity, abort signal, snapshot and update callback; errors normalized.
Pending user message aborts model request only; external abort aborts whole run, restore resets state while retaining model/tools/hooks.
Pending messages then prepareTurn and beforeModel hooks can rewrite messages/tools/options and stop.
beforeTool may change input/policy/context or skip; disabled/approval policy applied to dispatch.
read_files validates plural/ranged inputs and parallelizes independent read requests.
run_commands normalizes commands, invokes shell executor, is explicitly non-retryable; request-time shell description getter.
apply_patch and editor validate mutation args and call timed executors without auto-retry.
Read routes cline:// cache or resolves/stats real files with signal/size/model image limits.
Editor creates directories/files and reads content for unique replacement.
Shell spawns actual child process, captures bounded rolling output, gives execution identity and tracks detach support.
Abort/deadline kill process tree; verified PID/start-token supports detach to log, unref and releasing timeout/abort binding.
Detached logs capped10MiB and default24h retention; process-progress batching48ms.
Configured agent tools select child provider/model and scope tools/skills.
Enabled teams are instantiated/bootstrap wired, persist state on team events, hydrate/recover active runs, unlock lead tools.
Exact team native catalog; spawning lead-only, child tools exclude spawn and inherit delegated config.
Model team_send_message/broadcast/read_mailbox/mission_log dispatch actual runtime; receipt IDs and mark-read behavior.
Mailboxes store complete body; running teammates receive pending notification, broadcasts skip sender and lead.
Busy teammate cannot respawn; pending mailbox notification consumed by runtime callback;10minute request timeout.
Teammate run must be idle, includes unread mail, runs/continues and reports result/cancel/failure.
Recovered interrupted run uses fresh instruction to inspect workspace and avoid duplicated effects, not exact resumption of uncertain tool.
Compaction projects valid saved state and canonical tail before model, saves new state separately; manual fresh summary differs from incremental auto.
Source hash excludes volatile message ID/time but includes role/content/durable metadata and model metrics.
Compaction stores source count/hash/last key; invalid source prefix refuses projection, valid returns compacted messages plus canonical tail.
Manual compact rejects running current turn and persists compaction artifact when valid.
Model/mode config restart stops current session then seeds canonical messages/compaction, with startup generation barrier.
Hook audit JSONL captures selected run/tool inputs/results with wall timestamp; not all provider transport/process events.
Documented request ID covers final surfaced step, not hidden HTTP retries.
Documents canonical history separate from compaction artifact, while older already-compacted imports cannot recover omitted originals.
Conversation API retrieves/appends/replaces/restores messages, preserving display-only entries separately from runtime projection.
MCP settings/plugins register clients, load enabled tools, isolate errors, dispose manager on shutdown.
CLI/SDK/editor present; JetBrains implementation not open source.
Named model skills, ask_question and submit_and_exit definitions provide skill-load, host interaction and terminal completion.
search_codebase validates regex query inputs and invokes native executor via parallel Promise.all with output/time bounds.
Core internal SQL store indexes session metadata and artifact paths; this is not a model-native standing database tool.

tests.oracle: Mock SessionRuntime constructor/run; asserts selected provider/model/maxIterations, scoped tools and callback propagation; not live heterogeneous collaboration.

tests.focus: Shutdown of active queued teammate run
tests.oracle: Fake SessionRuntime promise rejects on abort; runtime classification/event assertions do not test actual provider cancellation.
Mock manager returns running; expects rejection and compactor/persistence not called. Source-level oracle for host gate only.

strengths: Runtime programming is actually wired through model/tool request boundaries.
Canonical transcript and prefix-validated compaction artifact prevent blindly reusing stale summaries.
Team mailboxes/task/run IDs and persistence establish collaboration beyond provider selection.
Stateful native mutation tools are explicitly non-retryable.
limits: Detailed search/outcome state machines, remote hub/cloud and all SDK extensions outside trace scope.
JetBrains source is unavailable; unpopulated evals/cline-bench submodule not inferred.
Mailbox delivery is notification/poll or next task enrichment, not immediate general live peer wake.
Bounded detached logs and surfaced request IDs do not meet full original audit.
arconaut_questions: Require explicit message delivery semantics for busy, idle and recovering peers.
Which canonical evidence should repair context after prefix mismatch rather than simply recomputing summary?
Keep detached daemons outside quiescence ownership while pausing genuinely harness-owned standing work.
Define model-native access to hook/workflow configuration without inheriting all host privileges.
